newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AutoZone raised to 1-Buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AutoZone raised to 1-Buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it had raised its recommendation for AutoZone Inc to 1-Buy.

-- Analyst William Julian said in a report the upgrade was prompted by "anticipation of strong growth in calendar 1997 and on recent weakness in the stock price. Our 12-month target of $39 remains unchanged as do our estimates."
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- The company's stock was trading up 3/8 to 27-3/4.
